title: Spring Is Here
overview: Alice becomes a second year high school student and experiences her second spring in Japan. With the addition of class A's homeroom teacher Kuzehashi-sensei, the "golden days" of best friends Shinobu, Alice, Aya, Yoko, and Karen continue to shine!

title: Present For You
overview: Kuzehashi-sensei is concerned that her dear students seem to be afraid of her. How can she get to know them better...? Seeing how well Karasuma-sensei gets along with her students, Kuzehashi-sensei asks her to teach her how to make friends with her students!

title: You're So Bright
overview: "I'm not actually English, and I dye my hair blonde!" Aya is shocked by Alice's astonishing confession! However, it was just a "Pretend April Fool's" prank put together by Alice and Karen. On April Fool's Day, the joke-loving English publish and broadcast lies in newspapers and TV.

title: Rain or Shine
overview: "I can go shopping by myself." Alice is irritated by the way Shinobu always treats her like a child. Suddenly she runs into Aya in the city who is striking a strange pose. When she asks why, Aya reveals she was mistaken for a middle school student. So it happens to Aya, too! Alice and Aya click when they realize they both share the same concern.

title: Come Play with Your Big Sister
overview: Unlike her younger sister Shinobu, Isami always looks sharp. However, lately she's been acting strange. Today she even put salt in tea. What's wrong with her? According to Shinobu, Isami is worried about her modeling career.

title: The Girl on My Mind
overview: The season of hunger (?). When Yoko nearly eats a plastic food sample, Karen suggests she takes on a super giant parfait. I may have been born for this! When Yoko gets overexcited, Aya can't help but interject.

title: My Dear Hero
overview: Summer is coming. Drawn by its scent, Karen switches to her summer style! The others are confounded by her excessively wild style, and Karen trembles in fear when Yoko says the school might finally call her parents. Apparently Karen's mother is terrifying.

title: Almost Summer Vacation
overview: It's almost summer vacation. Yoko announces she wants to plan her summer, and this year she's going to the beach! But before they can enjoy their summer vacation, they must finish their final exams...

title: A Special Day
overview: Summer vacation starts today. As Alice enjoys sleeping in, a suspicious figure approaches... Meanwhile, Aya borrows Yoko's summer assignment notebook to create a "No More Tears on the Last Day Homework Schedule!"

title: Seaside Promise
overview: It's finally time to go to the beach. The girls can hardly wait. The excited girls are in high spirits as they head towards the beach. They're nearly at their destination!

title: A Long Night
overview: It's the middle of summer vacation. As bright green trees sway in the wind, Honoka practices hard with her club. Due to her mysterious shouts featuring blonde hair, she's been playing especially well lately!

title: Because I Love You More Than Anything
overview: A green summer landscape. Cute honey-colored houses. Alice walks down a path with Poppy. Alice and Karen have returned to England. She'd glad to see her family again, but she still misses Shinobu. But the distance between them makes their friendship even stronger.
